verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that Copilot Chat is available inside Teams and that users can interact with it using work data. Nothing shows natural-language commands actually operating Teams itself, such as creating channels, scheduling meetings, or managing settings. The agent and bot docs (agent creation, slash commands, prompt starters, Agents Toolkit CLI) are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of Teams actions and settings, detail on what Copilot in Teams can do, independent or hands-on corroboration.
